name: Bahurim
brief: Village near Jerusalem, home of Shimei, who cursed David.
short: Bahurim (or Baharum) was a village near Jerusalem, known as the home of Shimei, who cursed David. (<ref="2Sa.3.16; 16:5; 17:18; 19:16; 1Ki.2.8; 2Sa.23.31; 1Ch.11.33">2Sa.3.16; 16:5; 17:18; 19:16; 1Ki.2.8; 2Sa.23.31; 1Ch.11.33</ref>)
